changes.Steam_menu: fixed-command Windows helper focuses genuine Steam and injects Ctrl+1; Esc removed

changes.account: native confirmation then genuine steam://changeuser UI; no credentials/token/cache manipulation
changes.virtual_controller: reserved player1 before Steam enumeration even with overlay hidden; generic HID + XInput for Steam session; ensure a controller layout when enabled

local_checks: final debug dylib and bundled PE markers
production safe-area placement/persistence calculation and finite-command host checks

device.launch: explicit genuine Big Picture launch succeeded
device.UI_validation: pending user drag/virtual navigation/Steam menu checks; Mac CUA reports locked
device.account_switch: not invoked by agent; no credential automation

limits: graceful close may require confirming a game save dialog
automatic game selection limited to visible standard steamapps/common game windows; ambiguous games require foreground selection
command dispatch acknowledgement is not proof a Steam UI opened
controller API enumeration is not proof Steam accepted touch button events
